messages:
tara: quick follow-up to the onboarding pipeline thread

proposal: make the deep compatibility checks an async, resumable harness that runs post-ingest. keep a tiny inline smokecheck to let fastpath through.

vik: sounds good. how should we pick samples so cost stays bounded?

tara: stratified sampler: small buckets by seqlen, token-rarity, and recent-prod-signals. default N=1500. cheap and catches edge cases.

sam: checkpointing is critical. harness should store cursor per-model-ver and restart without redoing already-checked samples.

tara: agreed. store cursor + bundle id (model ref, sampler seed, adapter version) in registry. include reproducible example snippets for failures.

vik: runtime parity: run harness with runtime profiles derived from metadata (quant, seqlen, batch). start with top-3 most-likely combos.

sam: adapter contract change: adapter.check(model_ref) -> ordered findings with severity + minimal repro. example: [{code:IO_MISMATCH,severity:critical,example:'input shape 0x...'}].

tara: UX: POST /models/:v/harness -> job_id + ETA. GET /harness/:job_id streams per-sample findings. add fastfail param.

infra-bot: note: bench pool quotas apply (bench-prod cap=10). avoid running many large harnesses in parallel.

vik: action items: tara write RFC update, sam implement checkpoint + artifact bundling, i'll prototype the sampler and cost calc. sync next Mon.
